title: Ericsson and Erillisverkot demonstrate 5G ISAC drone detection for Finnish authorities
summary: As unauthorized drones pose a growing challenge to national security, public safety and critical infrastructure, Ericsson and Erillisverkot have shown how 5G networks can help authorities detect, locate and track drone activity in real time. The companies tested Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC) during a September 16–18 technology demo in Helsinki, including a live trial at Vuosaari Harbor. The demonstration showed how ISAC can add a scalable sensing layer around ports, borders and other sensitive sites to strengthen Finland’s security and preparedness.
